page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top centre, page number at the top left. No marginal notes. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: Σημ.
main_text.p: Fit ab actiuo futuro secundo, mutando ω in ἠσομαι. Carent autem hoc futuro passiuo & ab eo derivatis, verba in μι.
main_text.head: Futurum quintum.

page.notes: Greek forms are copied from a small, faded print; several Greek words in lines 3 and 4 and the Sic line are doubtful and may contain printing errors. The head "Σημ." is printed as a Greek word with a doubtful first letter. The catchword "τιμά-" is taken from the lower right, where the line breaks off.
